findings.title: K's ModalLoopAuxK cannot supply a closed AuxStepPreserved witness in its current form
findings.detail: ModalLoopAuxK (phi0) (e) (b) (acc) freezes e to fit Aux's bare (b -> acc -> Prop) type. AuxStepPreserved's own step hypothesis universally quantifies over an independent, per-call e. A minting step changes outDeg against the step's own current expanded set, not against ModalLoopAuxK's frozen e -- concrete counterexample: frozen e0 := [] with any boxNeg/diamondPos-shaped step that mints an edge makes the post-state outDegEq conjunct false. modalStepHintikka_preserves_inv itself remains fully generic and sorry-free for any Aux genuinely satisfying AuxStepPreserved/AuxBounds (confirmed concretely for S5w via the landed modalStepHintikka_preserves_inv_S5w).
findings.recommendation: Phase 12 (the parametric Hintikka lift) will need to thread the current e explicitly through K's Aux instantiation rather than freezing it, or otherwise redesign how K's rank-dependent invariant interacts with the per-step-changing e. Flag this to the Phase 12 dispatch before it begins the K re-derivation regression gate.
